Create a single game tile sheet image for an isometric 2D game. Theme: Minoan sci-fi palace
architecture — cream limestone and red-plastered walls, Minoan frescoes (charging bull,
bull-leapers, dolphins, lilies, spirals, waves), red tapering Minoan columns with black
capitals, gold trim, deep blue tech panels with glowing cyan light strips, horns of
consecration. Painted, detailed, clean edges, consistent style across all pieces.

=== CANVAS (exact) ===
- Image size: exactly 2048 x 1920 pixels.
- Background: one flat solid colour, pure magenta #FF00FF, everywhere that is not a piece.
  No gradient, no texture, no vignette, no grid lines, no borders, no frames, no labels,
  no text, no title, no numbers, no drop shadows on the background.
- Grid: 8 columns x 6 rows of invisible cells, each cell exactly 256 x 320 pixels
  (cell x = col*256, cell y = row*320). Exactly ONE piece per cell, never crossing its cell.

=== PROJECTION (exact, no perspective) ===
- True 2:1 isometric (dimetric) pixel-art projection: every receding edge rises exactly
  1 pixel vertically per 2 pixels horizontally (angle 26.565°). Vertical edges stay perfectly
  vertical. NO perspective, NO vanishing points, NO camera tilt, NO fisheye — parallel lines
  stay parallel. Every piece in the sheet uses this same projection and the same scale.
- Light comes from the upper-left for every piece. Faces turned to the left/front-left are
  lit; faces turned to the right are about 20% darker.

=== PIECE GEOMETRY (exact, in pixels, relative to each cell's top-left corner) ===
FLOOR / ROOF TILE = a flat diamond, 256 wide x 128 tall, corners at
  top (128,176), right (256,240), bottom (128,304), left (0,240).
  Flat top surface only, no side thickness. It must tile seamlessly with copies of itself
  edge to edge (patterns continue across edges).

WALL "LEFT" (wall running down-right, facing the viewer's left) = a parallelogram,
  corners (64,8) -> (192,72) -> (192,312) -> (64,248).
  i.e. 128 px wide, 240 px tall, top and bottom edges slope DOWN to the right at 2:1.

WALL "RIGHT" (wall running up-right, facing the viewer's right) = a parallelogram,
  corners (64,72) -> (192,8) -> (192,248) -> (64,312).
  i.e. top and bottom edges slope UP to the right at 2:1.
  Walls are seen face-on: draw only the front face (no top thickness, no side), filling
  the parallelogram completely. Left and right ends of each wall must tile seamlessly
  with the next wall segment (stone courses, friezes and trim continue across the joint).
  Every wall has the same base: a dark stone dado along the bottom 12%, and a cream cornice
  band along the top 6%.

DOORWAY WALL: same parallelogram, but the door opening is fully transparent (magenta)
  from 27% to 73% of the wall's width and from 36% of its height down to the bottom,
  framed by a gold/bronze door frame.

STANDING OBJECTS (columns, props, decor): stand upright, centred horizontally in the cell,
  base touching y = 304 at x = 128, never wider than 220 px or taller than 300 px.
  Include only a small soft contact shadow directly under the object, nothing else.

=== CELL CONTENTS (row by row, columns 0..7) ===
Row 0 — FLOOR TILES (diamond): 0 cream stone paving, 1 cream stone paving variant,
  2 large limestone slabs, 3 blue-and-gold Minoan mosaic with spiral, 4 mosaic variant
  (dolphins), 5 glowing cyan tech floor panel, 6 red-ochre courtyard tiles, 7 worn stone.
Row 1 — WALLS facing LEFT (parallelogram "LEFT"): 0 plain red plaster, 1 plain cream
  ashlar stone, 2 fresco charging bull, 3 fresco bull-leapers, 4 fresco dolphins,
  5 small window (dark glass, gold frame), 6 tech window with cyan glow, 7 DOORWAY.
Row 2 — WALLS facing RIGHT (parallelogram "RIGHT"): the same eight designs as row 1,
  in the same order, drawn for this orientation and lighting (not mirrored text/images —
  re-drawn so frescoes still read correctly).
Row 3 — ROOF TILES (diamond): 0 flat cream roof terrace, 1 blue tech roof slab with panels,
  2 roof slab with skylight, 3 roof with solar panel, 4 roof garden (grass + flowers),
  5 roof slab with vent grilles, 6 gold-trimmed roof terrace, 7 plain dark roof.
Row 4 — ARCHITECTURAL PIECES (standing objects): 0 red Minoan column (tapering downward,
  black round capital, gold bands) exactly 272 px tall, 1 gold column 272 px tall,
  2 horns of consecration (gold), 3 small roof dome (blue glass, gold frame),
  4 antenna mast, 5 roof corner cap, 6 red banner with a double axe (labrys) on a pole,
  7 holographic beacon (blue glowing sphere on a pedestal).
Row 5 — DECOR (standing objects): 0 large painted urn (pithos), 1 small amphora,
  2 olive tree in a pot, 3 cypress tree, 4 bronze fire brazier, 5 stack of supply crates,
  6 tech cargo container (glowing cyan), 7 flower bed with lilies.

=== RULES ===
- Keep every piece inside its cell; leave at least 4 px of magenta around each piece.
- Use the exact sizes above so all pieces share one scale: a wall is exactly one storey
  (240 px), a floor/roof tile is exactly 256 x 128.
- Do not use magenta (#FF00FF) or near-magenta colours anywhere in the artwork.
- No text, no labels, no captions, no watermark anywhere on the image.
